Add animation to buttons

Enhance 'style.css'

Optimized styles for better readability and aesthetics. Adjusted fonts, colors, and layout across sections, including the header, hero, paracetamol section, footer, and more. The changes contribute to a cohesive and visually appealing design on the 'Know Your Pill!' website.

Add navigation links to header in 'index.html'

Incorporated navigation links in the header section, providing easy access to 'About Us,' 'Restricted Drugs,' and 'Quick Help' pages. Links enhance user navigation and overall website accessibility.

Refine styles in 'style.css' for 'section 2'

Adjusted colors, font sizes, and layout properties to create a cohesive design. Introduced consistent spacing and alignments using flexbox. Enhanced the hero section, including the title ('.heromain'), button, and symbol container. Applied a clean style to the new section ('.section2') about paracetamol metabolism.

Refine 'Know Your Pill!' content and structure

Updated the hero section layout within '.container' for better alignment. Introduced a new section ('.section2') with relevant content about paracetamol metabolism. The overall design aims for a more user-friendly and informative experience on the section 2 of 'Know Your Pill!' website.

Enhance styling in 'style.css'

Optimized and refined the styles for a cleaner and more visually appealing design. Adjusted colors, font sizes, and layout properties to improve readability and aesthetics. Introduced new styles for the hero section, including the main heading ('.heromain') and the symbol container ('.symbol'). Applied flexbox properties for better alignment in various sections. The 'Explore Now!' button and related elements now have improved styling within the '.container'.

Revise 'Know Your Pill!' homepage structure

Refine the structure of the homepage header to enhance visual appeal and user experience. Introduced a container for better organization, adjusted class names for clarity, and updated the hero section layout. The 'Explore Now!' button is now part of a dedicated container. Incorporated additional improvements for a cleaner and more cohesive design in the header section.
